entities.name: Edward Douglas-Pennant, 1st Baron Penrhyn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Edward Gordon Douglas-Pennant, 1st Baron Penrhyn, was a British Conservative Party politician, landowner in Wales, and slave owner in Jamaica. He played a major part in the development of the Welsh slate industry.
